page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor operating at 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB per core, and includes a single NVIDIA Pascal P4 GPU with 8 GB of VRAM. There is no local storage bundled with this instance, and the baseline network bandwidth is rated at 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the CPU and memory subsystems operate in lower performance tiers. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance score of 953.38 falls into the bottom 10%, while the multi-core score of 4755.08 is in the bottom 25%. Memory bandwidth tests show weak throughput, with read-only large block speeds at 37.18 GB/sec and write large block speeds at 25.34 GB/sec. Passmark CPU testing yields an average score of 6698.53, though database operations and Redis SET performance remain in the bottom 25%.

The primary tradeoff of this instance is its reliance on older Intel Broadwell CPU architecture and Pascal-generation GPU hardware, which limits its raw compute and memory throughput compared to modern architectures. However, the inclusion of a dedicated NVIDIA P4 GPU provides hardware acceleration capabilities for workloads that can offload processing from the CPU. This configuration is suitable for entry-level GPU-accelerated tasks, light machine learning inference, legacy CUDA applications, and basic video transcoding where high-speed local storage is not required.
